description: Soulbound seat key for SYMPHONY ($OPUS). Minted automatically to a wallet on its first Encore claim in Rhapsody No. 1 — exactly one per wallet, no matter how many Passes it Encores. This key is the key to a guaranteed Overture (Tier 1) seat in Scherzo, the second movement (Season 2, planned), if and when Scherzo opens. Scherzo is planned, not promised: no dates, numbers or mechanics for it are announced. This key can never be transferred, approved, sold or burned.
name: SCHERZO — Season 2 Seat Key
